# `class` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "class" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/class/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `"knight"` \| `"archer"` \| `"sorcerer"` \| `"thief"` | required | The class: knight, archer, sorcerer or thief. |
| `name` | string | required | Display name, e.g. "Thief" (docs and debug tools). |
| `notes` | string | required | The class fantasy and where its data comes from. |
| `pitch` | string | required | The class card pitch on the new-game screen (mw-e19.5), until descKey text lands. |
| `verbs` | list of string (at least 3) | required | The three signature verbs the class card lists, e.g. "Parry" (mw-e19.5). |
| `nameKey` | string | — | Localisation key of the display name; absent = "class.<id>.name". |
| `descKey` | string | — | Localisation key of the class card pitch; absent = "class.<id>.desc". |
| `dialogueTag` | id | required | Tag on class-gated dialogue options, shown as e.g. [Thief] (mw-e22.6). Unique per class. |
| `iconId` | string | required | Class emblem asset id (style bible §15.1); a placeholder until the art lands. |
| `portraitId` | string | required | Class card illustration asset id (style bible §15.1). |
| `startingCapabilities` | list of string (at least 2) | required | Capabilities granted at new game, with the permanent class source (ADR-0004). |
| `signature` | list of string (at least 1) | required | Capabilities that define the class and are never shared (ADR-0004 "simple" rule). |
| `startingKit` | object | required | What the player starts with (grey-box; tuned during m2/m3). |
| `startingKit.gold` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Starting gold. |
| `startingKit.items` | list of object | — | Starting items. |
| `startingKit.items[].item` | ref → item | required | The item, from src/content/data/item/. |
| `startingKit.items[].count` | integer 1–9999 | `1` | How many the player starts with. |
| `startingKit.items[].equip` | boolean | `false` | Starts equipped in its slot (a single unit of an equippable item). |
| `proficiencies` | list of id (at least 1) | required | Proficiency tags the class has, matching items’ equip.proficiencies, e.g. "blades", "heavy-armor", "shields". Soft (mw-e17.4). |
| `armorCapacityKg` | number > 0 ≤ 60 | required | Equipped armor weight at 100% load (ADR-0003: knight 30, others 23). Kilograms. |
| `stats` | object | required | Start values of the supporting stats. |
| `stats.health` | integer 1–200 | required | Starting health (ADR-0004 stats table); grows only in +10 steps up to the cap. |
| `stats.stamina` | integer 1–200 | required | Starting stamina (ADR-0004 stats table); grows only in +10 steps up to the cap. |
| `stats.mana` | integer 1–200 | required | Starting mana (ADR-0004 stats table); grows only in +10 steps up to the cap. |
| `unlockChannels` | list of `"book"` \| `"trainer"` \| `"schematic"` \| `"trick"` \| `"deed"` \| `"tool"` (at least 1) | required | Progression channels that apply, the primary one first (ADR-0004). |
